rv.q: It's an evening of unadulterated bliss.
This generous, big-hearted piece is already being spoken of as one of the best new British musicals in years.
Matilda is a fabulous family fizzer.
The RSC's 'Matilda' is the best British musical in years.
They have created a fresh and intelligent family entertainment that brings joy to both adults and children (crucially never patronising the latter).
It's spectacular, satirical and emotional too — a sign of how Matilda the Musical is going to have its cake and eat it.
It's hard to imagine a show capturing the spirit of Roald Dahl's literary world more perfectly than this one.
Matilda The Musical, produced by the Royal Shakespeare Company, is an explosion of energy, colours, creativity and talent.
Matilda the Musical is nevertheless hugely enjoyable and cracking Christmas fun.
His words have been taken to heart in Matthew Warchus’s brilliant, OTT (if over-amped) production.
The choreographed children have been drilled to within an inch of their life and the set piece numbers are startingly good.

cn.t: Critics hail this RSC adaptation as the best British musical since "Billy Elliot," praising Tim Minchin's clever score, Dennis Kelly's script, and spectacular performances—particularly Bertie Carvel's Miss Trunchbull and the remarkable child actors.
